description:
RESTATED 2026-09-03 after research (prototype E') and a cold review (BLOCK,
precise prerequisite). Base 0889c0b3a.

THE MECHANISM: Types::convergence_class_at (types/mod.rs:780-796), reached
from World::canonical_activation_key's recursive branch (world.rs:1884) via
convergence_collapse (:845) and its DispatchDemand::Ignore arm (:1016-1032),
turns a pure list slot into list(address_var) and a pure callable slot into
address_var -- fz-y6w bounded specialization as documented ("list(int) and
list(any) share one recursive key"). List.reduce_step/3's mask is [Ignore,
TupleFields({0: Whole}), Ignore] so its key is [[a0_e], {:cont, [a1_1_e]},
a2]: ONE activation for every Enum.reduce/3 user, one JOINED return.
reduce_cont/3 escapes only because its ListShape(Ignore) mask descends to the
element; nest the element one list deeper and it collapses too.

THE INVARIANT VIOLATED: an activation's published return may depend only on
what its key names. reduce_step/3 FORWARDS the list to reduce_cont/3 whose key
IS ground in the element, so the element decides the callee activation and
the return; the key erased it. LIVE AT HEAD, all three doors (repro183.fz):
    dbg(Enum.with_index([["a"], ["b"]], fn (x, _i) -> M.strings(x) end))
    dbg(Enum.with_index([[1], [2]], fn (_x, i) -> i end))
-> error[spec/violation]: strings/1 ... ([binary] | [int]); delete the
second line and it prints [1, 1]. Also at HEAD: swapping two independent
statements flips reduce_step/3's published return FACT (fz-kdt.190). The @spec
results of List.reduce_cont/3 / Enum.reduce/3 silently re-correlate the
joined return per callsite today; fz-kdt.120's honest rule removes that
accident, which is why 120 is blocked here (proto120 alone turns
enum_map_family red with a phantom spec/violation on */2; with the element
keyed it is green).

POPULATION: 146 blind-shared activations (free var in key AND >= 2
publishers with different evidence) over 30 functions / 46 fixtures.

WHAT E' (keep the element in EVERY list slot, 18 lines) BUYS AND COSTS,
measured on 597 fixtures: repro green on three doors; corpus FIFO/LIFO canon
movers 2 -> 0 (00277 and dead_closure byte-identical); enum_predicate_search
206 -> 166 executables and its blind-escape census 3 -> 0; EVERY LIVE
SURFACE-MEMBERSHIP ESCAPE ON THE CENSUS RETIRED (00277 12 -> 0, arms:6 12 ->
0, enum_predicate_search 1 -> 0 -- fz-kdt.179's reproducer included); blind-
shared 146 -> 78; 0 behaviour movers; enum_map_family green with 120 stacked.
COST: executables 5297 -> 5383 (+86, every riser a list-accumulator walker)
because (a) list_element_type([]) is none so every accumulator mints a
{empty_list(), list(τ)} ladder whose product is 2^k (partition/4 1 -> 4,
split4/6 1 -> 16, all code-identical) -> fz-kdt.124 BLOCKS this ticket; and
(b) E' is NOT NECESSARY: a slot the body never reads nor forwards (loop(n,
junk) with junk `nothing carrier=Absent`) splits from 1 to 2 activations
with identical bodies -- freight splits the invariant never asks about.

THE RULE TO BUILD (after 124): element precision only where DEMAND reaches
the element, and demand propagates THROUGH FORWARDING: a slot the body
forwards to a callee whose key is ground at that position inherits that
callee's demand (the dispatch-mask idea "key on what the body reads", made
transitive over StaticCallees -- the same walk derive_call_graph_component
does; fz-kdt.189 asks the same of consumes_callable_identity). reduce_step/3's
list slot then keys [int] (reduce_cont/3 reads the head); loop/2's junk slot
stays freight. The callable slot (a2) stays blind here -- fz-kdt.189.

REFUTED, do not rebuild: keep the callable verbatim (7 fixtures hit the arg-
floor family, fz-kdt.189); per-row / per-publisher return correlation
(quicksort prints [3]: ActivationInputAlternatives rows are the caller's own
ASCENT HISTORY as well as publishers, the cross-row join IS the fixpoint);
E'' (empty rung keyed as an address var: renames rungs, does not merge them).

RED-FIRST GATES: repro183 prints [1, 1] / [0, 1] on three doors; enum_map_
family green with 120's rule applied; reduce_step/3 keys [[int], {:cont,
[int]}, a2]; order-flip invariance on the two-user with_index program; corpus
FIFO/LIFO movers 0; partition/4 ONE activation with a ground element (124's
gate, must still hold); FREIGHT gate: loop(n, junk) at two junk element types
keys ONE activation (green at HEAD, red under E'); the two construction gates
re-aimed (multi-member wrappers 114 -> 72, still on 13 fixtures:
enum_take_drop_split 23; same_lambda_two_capture_types_dynamic 2); the
quicksort frontier gate asserts one partition/4 activation AND
display(inputs[2]) == "[int]", the schedule gate's bound stays 17 (derived);
fz-kdt.131's source reproducer dispatch_list_head_separates re-homed or the
loss recorded on 131 (its census entry empties).

RIP-OUT / DOCS: convergence_collapse's "list(int) and list(any) share one
recursive key" (mod.rs:841-844), convergence_class_at's doc + address-var
justification, type-specialization.md:105-135 (the Cartesian-product danger
paragraph and "the whole list family folds to one class"; the termination
carriers), type-world.md:73-76, addressed-arrow.md:136-143, dispatch-
matrix.md:746 (says THREE schedule movers -- stale at HEAD: two), drive_test.
rs:10240-10246, the old-law tests (types_test convergence_collapse_widens_
only_non_dispatch_slots, world_test x3, recursive_keying_sees_recursion_
through_generated_lambdas) REWRITTEN to the new law, the two ratchet
censuses edited deliberately with the cure recorded, specs.md's "shared
library bodies carry JOINED activation evidence" (element half struck,
callable residue named). BLOCKED BY fz-kdt.124. BLOCKS fz-kdt.120.

comments.text: RESEARCH DONE (2026-09-03, prototype + corpus; report + proto183.diff in the coordinator's scratchpad, being cold-reviewed). CANDIDATES measured: keep the callable in the key -> 7 fixtures hit the multi-target-closure arg-floor (fz-kdt.189, blocked behind runtime demand); per-row/per-publisher return correlation -> quicksort prints [3] (rows are the caller's own ASCENT HISTORY as well as publishers; the cross-row join IS the fixpoint); stop the coalesce blend -> sound but does not cure (fz-kdt.188). RECOMMENDED E': convergence_class_at keeps the list ELEMENT (18 lines): repro green on three doors, corpus FIFO/LIFO canon movers 2 -> 0 (dead_closure AND 00277 byte-identical), enum_predicate_search's blind-escape census empties, blind-shared 146 -> 78; cost executables 5297 -> 5383 (+1.6%) and the fz-y6w quicksort frontier bound moves (partition/4 1 -> 4; convergence still identical on every schedule) -- the bound must be RE-DERIVED, not re-pinned, which is the cold review's first question. With fz-kdt.120's prototype on top: enum_map_family GREEN, enum_tier0 + fz_f98_map_reduce oracle-exact. Gate 2 as written ("no free type variable") is not met by E' -- the callable slot stays a2 (fz-kdt.189); restate to the list and accumulator positions.

title: A recursive activation key keeps a list element wherever demand reaches it -- through forwarding, not everywhere -- so one Enum.reduce/3 user cannot publish another user's return
